texts: Elective replacement of the ascending aorta now carries an operative mortality below 5 percent: A.
In the picture, Zoro's new white tube goes in while the coffin in the corner is a tiny toy painted 5.
In Marfan syndrome a dissection does shorten long-term survival, which is why the root is replaced before it can dissect.
Valve-sparing operations do best when the annulus is not dilated; a large annulus predicts regurgitation later.
More regurgitation appears late after the remodelling (Yacoub) operation than after reimplantation (David).
Memory hook: a new white tube for the orca, and a toy coffin under 5.
